failure_modes: Slow drift (0.1 m/s): nu increase below GPS noise floor
Fast drift (1.0-2.0 m/s, ungated): Kalman absorbs spoof
Slow drift (all, gated): gate rejects spoof but CUSUM never accumulates
High FPR: natural nu spikes from 3m GPS noise exceed slack k
paper_narrative: The physical-only EKF+CUSUM baseline detects mid-range drifts (0.3-0.5 m/s) but fails at both extremes: slow drift is below the noise floor, and fast drift is absorbed by the Kalman filter. FPR of 60-70% makes it unusable for deployment. This motivates (1) f_theta to reduce nominal innovation variance, (2) the innovation gate to prevent absorption, and (3) the cooperative graph layer for cross-UAV verification.
